positive.point: Offering exclusive and high-quality products can create a sense of prestige and desirability, as seen in the idea of selling limited edition hoodies with premium designs.
Using a custom stamp for packaging is a cost-effective and flexible solution for small businesses to maintain brand consistency without overcommitting to large inventory.
The use of local printing and word-of-mouth marketing can be effective strategies for small businesses to build a loyal customer base and maintain quality control.
Designing mobile-friendly images by keeping important elements in the center ensures a polished look across devices, enhancing user experience.

negative.point: Inconsistency in branding elements like fonts and colors across different platforms can make a brand appear less professional and cohesive.
Custom packaging can quickly become obsolete due to changes in branding or product specifications, leading to wasted inventory and financial loss.
The challenge of standing out in a saturated market, such as the t-shirt industry, where many rely on viral marketing without a solid foundational strategy.
Mobile image cropping issues can make a website look less polished, affecting the overall perception of the brand.
